usedFor: Typeform holds form answers and Reply holds campaigns, so “When a form is submitted” can run “Create Person”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a form is submitted” in Typeform, then “Create Person and Push to Campaign” in Reply
bestTemplate.why: A submission creates the person and adds them to a campaign in one step, so follow-up starts at once.

watchOut: “When a form is submitted” runs on every submission, so a repeat submitter is pushed to the campaign again.
